name: Product on a table
summary: Your product in its setting, with shifting daylight and a slow push-in.
outcome: Your product in its setting, with daylight shifting slowly and a gentle push-in.
photoGuidance: A photo of the product in use or on a table.
The product clearly visible and in focus.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: The product
inputs.help: For example, 'oud perfume bottle on a marble tray'.
inputs.example: Oud perfume bottle on a marble tray

options.label: Gentle
options.prompt: The camera moves very little, a slow and steady drift.

options.label: Slow push-in
options.prompt: The camera pushes in slowly and steadily towards the subject.

options.label: Sideways glide
options.prompt: The camera glides slowly and steadily to one side, keeping the subject in frame.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject}.
prompt.composition: Keep the framing of the photo, with the product as the main subject.
prompt.environment: The setting stays as in the photo.
prompt.lighting: Natural daylight that shifts slowly across the scene.
